judgments.reason: The exact phrase 'Several foci showed papillary projections lined by multilayered epithelium with atypical cells, few mitotic figures, and areas of necrosis but no dermal invasion' appears literally in the histopathological findings, and these features (cytologic atypia, mitoses, necrosis without invasion) clinically support characterizing the lesion as hidradenoma papilliferum with atypical features.
